checks.lead: Kenesary Qasymuly,  or Kenesary Khan (Kazakh: کناشیرین خان, Кенесары хан, romanized: Kenesary xan; 1802–1847) was the last khan of the Kazakh Khanate, grandson of Ablai Khan, from the clan of Genghisid-Töre.  He fought to protect the independence of Kazakh lands and attempted to restore the traditional khanate rule.
